dynamic_evidence.independent_verifier_residual: GOWORK=off go test ./... had one real compile error: main.go undefined physics

root_cause.why_existing_guard_missed: Runtime.v2 already bounded transport payloads and heartbeats used an identity-only snapshot, but durable non-heartbeat facts remained unbounded.

behavior: Keep settlement-critical adapter fields, artifact paths, quality errors, and write-tool evidence in the durable task-row snapshot.

Replace omitted audit history with a deterministic SHA-256, source byte count, schema, and omitted-field list; full transcripts remain in ContextOS/ReceiptStore and the task owner row.

remaining_risks: Run the broader TaskRuntime service suites before r35.
Fresh r35 must prove lifecycle facts stay bounded during same-run repair and that settlement authority remains intact.
